edits.rationale: The AWS blog states that Atlas Search periodically snapshots Lucene index files to S3 and that a fresh instance rebuilds from the recent snapshot rather than reading the whole source collection. I found no MongoDB documentation that scopes snapshot reuse to eligible dedicated Search Nodes without customer key management, so that second sentence is dropped. The blog only says dedicated-node customers benefit; the CMK exclusion is unsupported.

edits.rationale: The AWS/MongoDB blog states Atlas Search is based on Apache Lucene and that search runs in mongot separate from the database process mongod. MongoDB docs say mongot does the search and scoring, then mongod does the full document lookup, and that Search Nodes handle search separately from main database operations.
